# Rivertown Pediatrics

> A comprehensive pediatric practice in Columbus, GA offering well-child visits, sick care, telemedicine, lactation support, and specialized services for children.

Rivertown Pediatrics is a patient-centered medical home practice led by pediatricians Mark Oliver, Susan McWhirter, and Erik Heiss, serving the Columbus, Georgia community with integrated clinical services and digital patient engagement tools.

## Key Topics

- Well-child visits
- Immunizations
- Telemedicine
- Patient-Centered Medical Home
- Sick child visits
- Lactation support
- New patient registration
- ADHD management
- Asthma care
- Behavioral health
- Newborn care
- Developmental screening
- Pediatric referrals
- Patient portal
- Columbus, GA location
